# Kieren Hussey

> Full Stack Developer based in Ontario, Canada. I build web applications end to end — from Angular and React frontends to Rails and Spring Boot backends — and games in C++ on the side.

## Skills
- Frontend: Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
- Backend & Systems: Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, Python, SQL, C++
- Tools & Platforms: Git/GitHub, Azure, Linode, WebAssembly, Raylib

## Experience
- Jr. Software Engineer, Ministry of Children, Community & Social Services (Jan 2024 — Feb 2025)
  Worked on the My Benefits web app serving Ontario Works and ODSP recipients, building features across an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend.
- Computer Programming Graduate, Georgian College (2022 — 2024)
  Graduated from the Computer Programming program, covering full stack development, databases, and systems programming.

## Projects
- [My Benefits](https://mybenefits.mcss.gov.on.ca/auth/login)
  Government web app for Ontario Works and Ontario Disability Support recipients to view and manage their benefits.
  Tech: Angular, Spring Boot, Oracle SQL, Node.js, Azure
- [Your Learning](https://yourlearning.ca/)
  Learning hub for Kindergarten through Grade 12 students, built and deployed end to end.
  Tech: Ruby, Rails, SQLite, Linode
- [Fly Fall](https://flyfall.ca/)
  2D ship-flying game written in C++ and compiled to WebAssembly so it runs in the browser.
  Tech: C++, WASM, Raylib, GitHub
